notes.title: "Zodiac Landing" is on sale
notes.content:
Welcome to "Zodiac Landing"! The cosmic journey is about to unfold on Steam, inviting you to experience a unique interstellar adventure! In this captivating arcade game, you pilot a rocket through the vastness of space, dodging asteroid obstacles and ultimately landing on the target platform. Each landing is a challenge, and every planet awaits your courage to conquer.

"Zodiac Landing" ingeniously integrates the twelve zodiac signs into the game, with each successful landing illuminating a bright star in the sky, creating your own constellation chart. Feel the mysterious connections between the signs, use your skills to draw your unique trajectory among the stars.

Challenges await not only in the endless depths of space but also in the distinctive visuals and smooth controls, making each landing a visual feast.

Are you ready? In "Zodiac Landing," explore space, challenge the stars, break the boundaries of dimensions, and light up the constellation stars. Join us now and become a space explorer! Your zodiac legend is about to begin.
